name: better-sqlite3
description: Vendored better-sqlite3 13.0.3 (N-API): pure-JS lib + prebuilt binaries only. No binding.gyp and no install scripts, so PaaS build pipelines (Hostinger hbuilds, Render) never invoke node-gyp (their Python 3.6 cannot parse gyp). Runtime loads prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>.node via lib/binding.js — N-API binaries are Node-ABI-stable.
